errors.claim: Where 30% of People are 65 or Older
errors.reason: Only Japan is at 30% globally; the title implies a generalized state or misrepresents the global share.

Japan's value is 29.99% and China's is 14.91%, which is fractionally just over 2x, but visually or strictly speaking China is 15% and Japan is 30% making the ratio 2:1. However, claims comparing precise multipliers should be checked carefully. 29.99 / 14.91 = 2.011, so it is factually supported.
